levels.surface: جعفر بن عمرو بن أمية الضمري

notes: «أباه» is a bare kinship with no name, so relation kind; he is the Companion-level eyewitness
«وتابعه حرب بن شداد وأبان عن يحيى» names other transmitters in place of Shayban: a variant group, not a route
The Prophet is the end of the chain, not a link
